# CrackCMS — llms.txt

> AI-powered medical exam preparation platform for UPSC CMS, NEET PG, INI-CET, FMGE, USMLE and Medical Officer recruitment. Built by CrackLabs.

- Site: https://cracklabs.app
- API: https://crackcms-vsthc.ondigitalocean.app/api/
- Source: https://github.com/Divyanshu-Dubey/crack_cms
- Contact: support@cracklabs.app
- Primary markets: India (en-IN), United States, United Kingdom
- Languages: English
- Audience: MBBS / interns / postgraduate aspirants preparing for Indian and international medical competitive exams

## What this platform does

CrackCMS is a vertically-integrated medical exam-preparation SaaS that fuses a curated question bank with multi-provider AI tutoring grounded in standard textbooks and prior-year questions (PYQs).

Four interlocking value layers:

1. Question Bank — 1,920+ verified MCQs for UPSC CMS, NEET PG, INI-CET, FMGE, USMLE and Medical Officer exams with explanations, mnemonics, high-yield points, and textbook references.
2. AI Tutor — RAG-grounded chat tutor, concept explainer, mnemonic generator, and explain-after-answer that independently verifies the official answer key.
3. Adaptive Testing — Custom tests, full PYQ simulators with timed sessions, review mode, and analytics.
4. Progress Intelligence — Streaks, badges, leaderboards, topic-wise performance, weak-topic detection, score prediction, study roadmap.

## Exam tracks covered

| Track | Landing | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| UPSC CMS | /cms | 1,920+ PYQs, MCQ practice, cutoffs, books, strategy |

| FMGE | /fmge | Foreign Medical Graduate screening exam |
| USMLE | /usmle | Step-by-step US residency prep |
| Medical Officer | /medical-officer | State PSC, ESIC, NHM recruitments |
| Government Doctor Jobs | /government-doctor-jobs | Vacancies, eligibility, cutoffs |

## Knowledge Base (Monica AI)

RAG engine at `backend/knowledge_base` powers question answering with citations. Hybrid retrieval = BM25 + dense vectors + knowledge graph + Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

- Module: `backend/knowledge_base`
- Ontology: 80+ medical entities, 100+ relations
- Retrieval: hybrid BM25 + dense + KG + RRF
- Embeddings: `services/embedding.py`
- Ingestion: Internal corpus + NCBI + whitelisted Indian sources + user uploads
- Whitelisted sources: UPSC, MoHFW India, NHM India, NMC India, ICMR, NCBI, WHO, NHS, CDC, NICE, OpenMD, KEGG, DrugBank
- Refused: Harrison's, Bailey & Love, Marrow, PrepLadder — copyrighted material
- Citation engine: every answer carries `[Source Title — Page]` inline markers
- Monica assistant: `services/monica.py`

Endpoints:
- POST /api/kb/ask/ — Ask Monica
- POST /api/kb/search/ — Hybrid retrieval
- GET /api/kb/stats/ — KB statistics
- GET /api/kb/sources/ — Whitelisted source catalog
- POST /api/kb/upload/ — Upload user document
- POST /api/kb/ingest/ — Trigger ingestion
- POST /api/kb/index/ — Rebuild embeddings
- POST /api/kb/extract-kg/ — Extract knowledge graph
- POST /api/kb/eval/ — Run retrieval evaluation
- GET /api/kb/health/ — KB health probe

Management commands:
- `python manage.py load_ontology`
- `python manage.py build_kb --max 2000`
- `python manage.py ingest_source upsc|mohfw-india|nhm-india|nmc-india|icmr|ncbi`
- `python manage.py evaluate_kb`

## AI Providers (11 + local fallback)

Round-robin via `backend/ai_engine/services.py`. Thread-safe counter, 120s deadline, 15–20s per provider.

| # | Provider | Model | Free tier | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Groq | Llama 3.3 70B | 30 RPM | Fastest |
| 2 | Cerebras | Llama 3.1 8B | 30 RPM | Low-latency |
| 3 | Gemini | gemini-2.0-flash + flash-lite | 15 RPM | 2 keys |
| 4 | Cohere | Command-A | 20 RPM | Long-context |
| 5 | OpenRouter | Free models | 20 RPM | Key 1 |
| 6 | OpenRouter | Free models | 20 RPM | Key 2 (separate quota) |
| 7 | GitHub Models | GPT-4o Mini | 150 RPM | PAT-authenticated |
| 8 | HuggingFace | Llama 3.3 70B | 10 RPM | Inference API |
| 9 | Mistral | mistral-small | 30 RPM | |
| 10 | NVIDIA | Mistral 7B | TBD | build.nvidia.com |
| 11 | DeepSeek | deepseek-chat | Paid | Last resort |
| F | Ollama | llama3.2:3b | Local | Unmetered fallback |

Provider error phrases are filtered so users never see raw API errors.

## Token Economy

Every AI call costs 1 token.

| Pool | Quota | Reset |
|---|---|---|
| Daily free | 10 | Midnight (server TZ) |
| Weekly free | 50 | Sunday |
| Feedback reward | +2 per verified report | On approval |
| Purchased | Per-pack | Never |

Consumption priority: Daily → Weekly → Feedback → Purchased. Admin/staff bypass. Daily/weekly are auto-seeded into every TokenBalance row on the post_migrate signal.

## Authentication

Hybrid Supabase-first with Django JWT backup. django-axes locks accounts after 5 failed attempts (30 min). Supabase handles identity and device binding via accounts.UserDevice; frontend/src/lib/api.ts clears the local session and redirects on code: session_invalid.

## Technology stack

Frontend: Next.js 16.1.6, React 19.2.4, TypeScript 5, Tailwind 4, Radix UI, Axios, SWR, @supabase/ssr, Recharts, Playwright.
Backend: Django 5, DRF, SimpleJWT, django-axes, django-cors-headers, django-q2, dj-database-url, Sentry, Datadog, gunicorn, whitenoise.
Data: SQLite3 (Postgres-ready), Git LFS for PDFs and chroma_db.
AI: 11-provider rotation + Ollama fallback + TF-IDF RAG over chroma_db/rag_store.sqlite3.
Payments: Razorpay.
Observability: Sentry, Datadog RUM, GA4, GTM.
Hosting: Render (backend) + Vercel (frontend) + Supabase (auth).

## Principles

- Grounded answers — every AI response is cited to a textbook, PYQ, or whitelisted source.
- Multi-provider resilience — 11 providers + local Ollama so a single outage cannot take the platform offline.
- Token-aligned incentives — freemium free tier + paid Razorpay plans.
- Single-device enforcement — paid content is bound to one active device per user.
- Fixture-first question workflow — questions_fixture.json is the production source of truth.
- No PBN, no scraping, no copyrighted ingestion.
